description.value: Sushi 9 Nine is a Japanese restaurant in Abbotsford's South Fraser Way corridor, serving sushi and traditional Japanese cuisine with a West Coast twist. Located in a shopping centre unit, it offers both a full dine-in experience and a separate takeout/delivery menu, making it a flexible stop for cyclists on the go.
